summary: The grammar/forced token synchronization path called torch.distributed.all_reduce with ReduceOp.MIN even when DP attention selected a singleton attention-TP process group. The sampler now checks the selected group's world size and skips the identity collective when it is one, while retaining the existing MIN reduction for multi-rank groups.

tests.what_was_measured: Issue-specific regression: both grammar-triggered and environment-forced synchronization incorrectly called all_reduce for a mocked world-size-one group; the multi-rank MIN and no-trigger boundary cases passed. Raw output: reports/j-6c463aacbcb0/raw/regression-before.log

Four cases passed: singleton grammar sync skip, singleton forced sync skip, multi-rank ReduceOp.MIN preservation, and no-trigger avoidance of both size query and collective. Final raw output after formatting: reports/j-6c463aacbcb0/raw/regression-after-final.log

On the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 GPU, a real world-size-one NCCL-backend process group reported size one; the sampler left a GPU int64 token tensor equal to the independent expected tensor [17], and an all_reduce trap was not reached. Raw output: reports/j-6c463aacbcb0/raw/gpu-singleton-check.log
All applicable repository formatting, lint, credential, syntax, and registered-test CI validation hooks passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-6c463aacbcb0/raw/gpu-singleton-check.log records AMD Instinct MI350X, architecture (9, 5)/gfx950, backend nccl, world_size=1, token_ids=[17], expected=[17], and singleton_all_reduce=skipped.

remaining_limitations: Only one assigned AMD gfx950 GPU was available, so the reported 8x NVIDIA B300 DP-attention serving configuration was not reproduced.
The CUDA 13.0/NCCL 2.28.9 512 MiB NET shared P2P allocation signature could not be measured in this ROCm environment.
No model weights were needed for this sampler control-flow defect; consequently no full HTTP server, model-semantic, or multi-rank workload claim is made.
The multi-rank boundary is unit-verified by asserting the unchanged ReduceOp.MIN call, not executed on multiple physical GPUs.
